title: Dutch press unites in “Publeaks Foundation”, opens new whistleblower website: www.publeaks.nl
note: Opened live 2026-11-01 (post dated 2013-09-09T05:45). Dutch security researcher's blog on the Publeaks.nl launch: "However, as stated by @fpietrosanti, JavaScript is necessary for certain aspects of whistleblower security awareness" followed by his quote "Without using JavaScript it would not be possible to provide the usability required for whistleblower security awareness...". Identified via Twitter handle linked to twitter.com/fpietrosanti (name not spelled out in full). Same quote as the known Punto Informatico item.
